profile.summary:
A versatile and impactful Software Engineer with over 6 years of experience specializing in full-stack development with a focus on backend and cloud technologies. Expert in Python, Docker, and Kubernetes, with a proven track record of leading and delivering complex software solutions. Known for driving product innovation, efficiently scaling early-stage startups, and building high-performing engineering teams. Brings a strategic approach to product development and a passion for mentoring, coupled with a strong foundation in cloud architecture and microservices.

Throughout my career, I have had the opportunity to work on a wide range of projects, from small startups to large enterprise systems. I have experience in agile development methodologies and am well-versed in using modern technologies such as Python, TypeScript, Django, ReactJS, Java, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS.

In addition to my technical skills, I am an excellent communicator and collaborator. I enjoy working in a team environment, leveraging my skills and experience to contribute to the project's success. I am always eager to learn and take on new challenges to grow professionally and personally.

Outside of work, I enjoy reading about technology, watching movies, and playing video games. I also enjoy participating in hackathons, attending technical conferences, and coding challenges to keep my skills sharp and stay up-to-date with the latest trends in the industry. 

I am actively looking for full-time jobs. Please feel free to reach out to me.

contact: +1 3179126277
email: harenlewis29@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Spearheaded the deployment of PyTorch machine learning models using TorchServe and Docker on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) decreasing time to production by 50% 
- Streamlined patient analysis and report generation, cutting down processing time from 2 hours to 10 minutes through a custom Python tool, significantly enhancing caregiver efficiency 
- Conducted advanced time series data analysis on healthcare datasets with python and Pandas, extracting patient insights that informed data driven research

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a Python AI workflow orchestrator for building distributed data and machine learning (ML) pipelines 
- Revamped microservices for multi-cloud compatibility, replacing Amazon Web Services (AWS) services with Kafka queues, Kubernetes, and serverless functions, increasing customer signups by 40% 
- Spearheaded MongoDB integration achieving a 60% surge in database performance by optimal document definitions 
- Deployed an event-driven architecture on GCP, harnessing Pub/Sub and Cloud Functions to optimize scalability.
positions.insights: Skills: Containerization · Python (Programming Language) · Cloud Infrastructure · Server Architecture · Cloud Services

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and Developed 15+ efficient and performant microservices and REST API using Django Rest Framework.
- Integrated and developed REST APIs with modern reusable user interface UI components using React, Redux 
- Enhanced search backend API response time by 60% by implementing Elasticsearch and Python's Haystack, replacing MySQL MyISAM 
- Reduced latency to 20ms by implementing AWS Amazon CloudFront caching, S3 storage, and Route53 infrastructure to deliver content securely over the Content Delivery Network (CDN) 
- Minimized network and server requests by 30% using AWS Lambda triggers and CloudFront CDN caching
positions.insights: Skills: Containerization · Python (Programming Language) · RESTful WebServices · REST APIs · React · Full-Stack Development · Django · Amazon CloudFront · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon S3
